selection_rule: First image of each domain in RegionDataset built from frozen records.json filtered to split=val, preserving record order; no random sampling, no test images

count_definition: One argmax of softmax(router scores) per predicted proposal per image per decoder stage, including unannotated proposal slots. Counts are not pixel counts, actual anatomical regions, or the number of expert forward calls.
entropy_definition: Shannon entropy of all nine router probabilities; natural logarithm, in nats; normalized entropy divides by ln(9)
limitations: Only one seed and the first validation image per domain; not a random or representative estimate of the complete validation distribution.
All 16 latent proposal slots are counted, even when the corresponding output channel is unannotated; the frozen run has no direct proposal supervision.
Concentration in a sampled layer does not prove collapse in all data or all layers.
No Dice comparison, causal ablation, gradient measurement, or test evaluation is performed by this script.
Softmax probability and a discrete expert assignment do not measure the magnitude or utility of that expert contribution versus the shared branch.
